Timing of the later reverting reads relative to registration is not quantified; only 'later ... until removeSuppliedEntry clears it' is stated.

limitations: The intent is encoded as an ordering obligation: notifyVaultSupply may be called only after the slot is verified readable and active.

The impact is encoded as a potential later revert of totalBackingSigned()/distributableSurplus()/settleDailyPnL() until removeSuppliedEntry clears the entry; the three functions are treated as one outcome per the report fragment.
The report does not give a deterministic trigger for HyperCore leaving the slot inactive; the vulnerable scenario remains conditional.
